text:
Sam (AE): quick kickoff for the HydraEdge pilot — they want streaming with function/tool calls and strictly typed JSON outputs. main asks: handshake flow for our SDK, sample payloads for func calls, pricing for reserved capacity, and answers for their security questionnaire. can we align on next steps?
Tasha (SE): thanks — I can run the onboarding runbook. immediate items: 1) sample SDK snippet for SSE+funcjson, 2) handshake auth (ephemeral creds vs api key), 3) mapping of structured outputs -> their downstream schema.
Sam (AE): HydraEdge also asked about latency SLAs and fallback model when the dedicated pool is busy. pricing question — they want a ballpark for a 2-week POC with up to 50 qps sustained.
Mike (SDK Eng): pinged — i can share a minimal example for node + sse streaming with a function JSON schema. simple example below:
```js
// client init
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-2-large', stream: true });
stream.on('data', (chunk) => { console.log(chunk); });
// function call request (structured output)
await client.call({
  model: 'redwood-2-large',
  prompt: 'Extract invoice items',
  functions: [{ name: 'parse_invoice', schema: { type: 'object', properties: { items: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { desc: { type: 'string' }, qty: { type: 'integer' }, price: { type: 'number' } } } } } } ]
});
```
Mike (SDK Eng): key notes: use `functions` for structured outputs; SSE returns incremental partials, final call includes full `func_call` payload. we recommend using our client helper `await stream.collectFinal()` to get the final JSON blob and validation helpers in `@redwood/validate-schema`.
Tasha (SE): for the handshake: we can demo ephemeral creds via short-lived token exchange (1 min TTL) which works well for browser clients; for server-to-server POC we suggest short-lived role tokens minted by their identity provider and exchanged in our auth flow. HydraEdge requires on-prem compatibility notes — they'll need Private deployment for SOC2 + data residency.
Anjali (Security): re: questionnaire: they flagged KMS integration, audit logs retention (e.g., 90d vs 365d), and IP allowlist. confirm: Private supports customer-managed KMS and on-prem runs with HSM? also need details on our encryption-in-transit and at-rest certs for their review.
Mike (SDK Eng): yes — Private supports CMEK + HSM integrations. for hosted POC we can provide limited export logs and redact sensitive fields. also note: structured output validation happens client-side with schema helpers — server will not enforce customer schemas unless deployed in Private with strict validation enabled.
Sam (AE): pricing ask — any quick numbers for a POC: 2 weeks, 50 qps peak, streaming with function calls and 10M tokens estimated. they prefer a committed short-term seat on Dedicated if that reduces unit cost.
Tasha (SE): rough: POC reserved slot (small dedicated pool) + bandwidth for streaming — estimate $Xk/week for dedicated slot + usage. i'll confirm with finance but recommend offering a trial discounted reserved unit for evaluation.
Anjali (Security): also flag enterprise blocker: HydraEdge legal wants an on-prem install checklist and SOC2 + penetration test attestation. can we prepare a one-pager?
Tasha (SE): I'll assemble the on-prem checklist and a short SOC2/Pentest summary. Sam — can you surface the specific fields in their security questionnaire (they highlighted 3 sections)?
Sam (AE): sharing extracts now — pasted below.
Sam (AE): "Q12: Do you support customer-managed KMS (Y/N)? Q18: Can logs be restricted to VPC only (Y/N)? Q21: Are private endpoints available for ingestion?"
Tasha (SE): answers to those: KMS = Yes (Private + Dedicated via CMEK), logs to VPC = Private only, private endpoints = Yes for Private + Dedicated peering. will draft language.
deploy-bot: created ticket SD-7123 for HydraEdge POC onboarding docs and attached runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hydraedge-poc
Sam (AE): perfect. next steps: Mike to drop final code sample + validation helper link by EOD, Tasha to draft pricing + on-prem checklist, Anjali to provide templated questionnaire answers. sync tomorrow 10am PT to confirm kickoff. :thumbsup:
Tasha (SE): noted. will also include quick troubleshooting tips for SSE reconnects and prefix caching behavior (they were worried about duplicate events).
Mike (SDK Eng): adding note — if they use client-side retransmit, recommend idempotency keys on tool calls to avoid duplicate function executions. sample header: `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>`
Anjali (Security): I'll include a recommended minimal retention policy and placement for audit logs for the POC.
Sam (AE): thanks everyone. I'll update HydraEdge with this plan and confirm the 10am sync. :rocket:
